boundary: Timing resistance is a separate claim; none is made and none is tested.

normalised_observation.rule: Every removed value MUST independently be valid for its own request. Normalisation compares two responses; it does not license omitting a required field or hiding a discriminator.

property: No read endpoint is an existence oracle: a signed, well-formed read of an existing resource by a principal outside its Audience Set, and a read of a nonexistent resource by the same principal, are equivalent under the normalised observation of Section 6.4.4.
